Good regression check for whether the agent retries with a narrower term after an empty result.

query: What's your return window for electronics, and is there a restocking fee?
notes: KB flaw trap #1 (marketsphere_kb_meta/FLAWS.md): runbook_electronics_returns_legacy.md (dated 2023-03-12, internal/Tier-1-2 only) contradicts current policy, saying 14 days / 20% fee. The correct customer-facing answer is 30 days / 15% (return_policy.md + electronics_return_addendum.md, both last-updated 2024-11-15). Grade on whether the agent's answer matches the current policy, not the stale internal runbook — and the runbook shouldn't be cited to a customer at all since it's support-internal.

query: What's the free shipping threshold?

A naive retriever may surface the archived doc for this exact phrasing. Grade on whether the agent answers $50, not $35.

query: How do I track my order?

ground_truth.answer_gist: Shipment confirmation email has a tracking link; also available under Account > Orders > View Tracking.

notes: KB flaw trap #3 (near-duplicate): faq_track_order.md and faq_track_order_alt.md answer the same question in different words. Good retrieval/reranking should consolidate rather than spend the whole top-k budget on two near-identical chunks. Note: intent_classifier_prompt.md would likely tag this order_status, not product_question — retrieve is still reachable there via general_support's tool set, or if the classifier leans product_question; grade on tool routing regardless of which intent bucket wins.

query: How long does it take to get my reimbursement after I send something back?

input.query: reimbursement timing after returning an item

ground_truth.answer_gist: 5-7 business days to process after receipt at the returns center, funds post to original payment method within an additional 3-5 business days.

notes: Vocabulary mismatch test: customer says 'reimbursement,' the KB's Refund Timing section (return_policy.md) says 'refund.' Checks that retrieval isn't purely keyword-literal.

query: My SilentFlow headphones won't turn on, and also - can I still return them if I bought them a month ago?

input.query: SilentFlow headphones won't turn on troubleshooting

ground_truth.troubleshooting: Charge for at least 30 minutes; if still unresponsive, hold power button 15 seconds for a hard reset.

notes: Cross-format query: product manual PDF (ms-head-1004.pdf troubleshooting section) + policy markdown (30-day electronics window) in one turn. Checks the agent handles two sub-questions needing two different KB documents/formats without dropping one.

query: How do I set up the HomeSense Smart Thermostat with my WiFi?

ground_truth.answer_gist: Needs a 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network (5GHz not supported on some HomeSense devices) and the HomeSense app; pair via QR code, connect to the device's temporary Wi-Fi, then your home Wi-Fi. It's hardwired, so homes without existing thermostat wiring may need professional installation.

notes: Direct product-manual lookup (ms-home-4002.pdf 'App Setup and Pairing' / 'Pre-Installation Checklist' sections) — cross-checks that setup guidance from a PDF manual surfaces correctly alongside markdown policy/FAQ retrieval.

query: How long is the warranty on the FlexTrack Smart Watch?
notes: Both the product manual (ms-fit-3001.pdf: 'Electronic FlexTrack devices include a 1-year limited warranty') and the general warranty_policy.md (1 year standard) agree here — no contradiction, unlike the electronics-return case. Good check that retrieval doesn't need to arbitrate when sources agree.

query: Do you ship to Canada, and who pays customs?
notes: Direct policy lookup, single canonical source (international_shipping_policy.md), no trap involved — a clean baseline alongside the flaw-trap cases.

query: Can I split payment between a gift card and a credit card?

input.query: split payment gift card credit card

ground_truth.answer_gist: Yes - you can split payment across multiple methods at checkout, e.g. a gift card plus a credit card for the remainder.

notes: Direct policy lookup for a payment question — this agent has no payment/billing tool or data, so retrieve is the only path to a correct answer.

query: Will I be charged a fee to cancel my order?

ground_truth.answer_gist: No charge to cancel as long as the order hasn't shipped yet.

notes: This is the CANCEL/check_cancellation_fee-style question that has no DB/tool backing (orders table has no fee field) — but it IS answerable correctly via retrieve against cancellation_policy.md, unlike the payment/invoice/account categories that have no KB coverage either.

query: My package arrived damaged, what do I do?

input.query: item arrived damaged what to do

ground_truth.answer_gist: Contact support within 7 days with photos; full refund or free replacement with expedited shipping, no return-shipping cost to the customer.

notes: Two KB documents (policy + FAQ) agree here, both answerable via retrieve. This scenario also has no dedicated tool (no 'report damage' tool exists), so retrieve is the only correct path — contrast with a return for buyer's-remorse, which should go through check_return_eligibility/initiate_return instead.
